scenes.title: ✈️ 机场接机寒暄

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Welcome to Shanghai! Did you have a smooth flight?

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.text: Yes, thank you. It was about 14 hours, but I managed to get some sleep.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's good to hear. The car is waiting outside. Shall we head to the hotel first?

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.text: That would be great. I could use a shower and a change of clothes.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Of course. The hotel is about 30 minutes from here. We can discuss the schedule on the way.

scenes.tips: 💡 关键短语：smooth flight（顺利的飞行）、head to（前往）、could use（想要/需要）

culture_tip.title: 跨文化小贴士：欧美客户篇
points: 👋 见面礼仪：握手要有力、眼神交流、面带微笑
📧 沟通习惯：欧美客户倾向直接坦诚的沟通方式，不喜欢拐弯抹角
🕐 时间管理：准时非常重要，迟到会被视为不专业
📊 谈判风格：注重数据和事实支撑，不喜欢空泛的承诺
🏠 私人空间：保持适当身体距离（约一臂），不要过于亲密

listening.title: Negotiating Price Terms
listening.text:
A: We've reviewed your quotation and it's a bit above our budget. Is there room for negotiation?
B: I understand. May I ask what target price you have in mind?
A: We're looking at around $12.50 per unit for an order of 5,000 pieces.
B: That's quite a stretch. At that volume, the best I can offer is $13.20, and that includes free shipping.
A: If we increase the order to 8,000, can you meet us at $12.80?
B: Let me check with our production team and get back to you by tomorrow. But I think we can work something out.
vocab: work something out（找到解决方案）

looks.title: 一字肩针织上衣 + 直筒牛仔半裙

top.desc: 浅粉色一字肩针织衫，露锁骨不露手臂，袖口微喇修饰

bottom.desc: 浅蓝直筒牛仔半裙，中长款过膝，前开衩设计

looks.tips: 一字肩拉长颈部线条，浅粉色衬橄榄皮；直筒牛仔半裙修饰胯部不紧绷；搭配3cm中跟米色凉鞋。

looks.title: V领收腰连衣裙 + 短款开衫

top.desc: 雾霾蓝V领收腰连衣裙，A字微摆不蓬松，七分袖遮手臂

bottom.desc: 米白色短款针织开衫，长度到腰线以上，强调高腰比例

looks.tips: V领显脸小、延伸颈部；收腰突出细腰优势；短开衫提高腰线，158cm也能穿出好比例！

items: 👡 米白色方头中跟凉鞋（跟高4cm）- 百搭色，粗跟好走不累
👠 裸粉色尖头中跟单鞋（跟高4.5cm）- 延伸脚背显腿长
🥿 编织坡跟凉拖（跟高3.5cm）- 休闲精致有呼吸感
shoes.tip: 小个子选鞋：尖头>圆头；裸色>深色；露脚背>全包裹；粗跟3-5cm最舒适
